integrity: All finite witness probabilities derive from exact rational enumeration; the general formula and stochastic extremality have analytic proofs. Historical priority and external mathematical validation remain open.
scientific_limitations: Distinct group-orbit statistics a.s.; iid auxiliary transformations supported on a finite elementary abelian 2-group; unconditional exchangeable null. Not a power-optimality theorem, and its moment law does not extend generally to three auxiliary draws.
title: Exact two-resample calibration and its sharp boundary for weighted involutive permutation tests
